# hyperping_escalation_policy (Data Source)

Fetches a single Hyperping escalation policy by ID or name via MCP.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The unique identifier (UUID) of the policy.
- `name` (String) The name of the policy to look up.

### Read-Only

- `steps` (Attributes List) The escalation steps. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--steps))
- `team` (String) The team name this policy belongs to.

<a id="nestedatt--steps"></a>
### Nested Schema for `steps`

Read-Only:

- `delay` (Number) Delay in minutes before the step is triggered.
- `target_id` (String) The ID of the escalation target.
- `target_type` (String) The type of the escalation target (user, schedule, integration).
